dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge exhibiting a deeply falcate curve with multiple irregular indentations and notches along the pixel boundary from the base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour measuring approximately 65-70 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Tall morphology where vertical pixel height significantly exceeds base width, with an approximate base-to-height ratio of 0.75:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple mechanical notches along the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; distinct white irregular patch/lesion on the dark lateral field near the anterior fin base; small dark punctate spots on the posterior light-colored skin.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp, high-contrast boundary between dark dorsal and light lateral pigmentation fields.
